meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 导入已有小说并拆解为可续写的创作项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手里有写好的小说，想把它纳入标准创作流程继续写。
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels and rebuild a structured writing project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an existing novel and want to bring it into a proper writing workflow.

howto.what: 你把已有小说(文件或全文)交给 Claude 后,它会拆解分析并重建标准项目结构——设定、大纲、正文、追踪——让你能直接续写;长篇短篇走不同流程。
howto.when: 当你说“导入小说”“反向解析”“把我的书导进来”等指令,或运行 /story-import 时触发;需要提供小说文件路径或粘贴文本。

say.note: 触发导入流程,先确认书名和写作目标。

say.text: 反向解析这本小说,我要能接着续写
say.note: 走完整迁移,生成可续写的项目结构。

say.text: 只导入拆一下,不做项目迁移
say.note: 只做拆解分析,不生成续写工程。

howto.what_en: After you give Claude an existing story (file or pasted text), it analyzes and rebuilds it into a standard project structure — settings, outline, chapters, tracking — so you can continue writing. Long and short works use separate pipelines.
howto.when_en: When the user says 'Import novel', 'Reverse-parse', 'Import my book', or runs /story-import; a source file path or pasted text is required.

say_en.note: Starts the import flow, then confirms title and goal.

say_en.text: Reverse-parse this novel; I want to continue writing it.
say_en.note: Runs the full migration into a project structure.

say_en.text: Import and analyze only, no project migration.
say_en.note: Runs the analysis without making a continuable workspace.
